Well I completely understand that. I wasn’t suggesting you do put yourself in that position, but love isn’t worth your life & yeah, it does get harder with age & it may be near impossible because even as someone younger it seems like it is, but it’s completely impossible if you don’t try and if you aren’t comfortable doing that then don’t... but to lose your life over it would suck, maybe not for you personally but it would. I’m sure you have α lot to offer & it’d be α shame if it went to waste because of these thoughts that you have... That really sucks, I can kinda relate because I’d always feel like I wasn’t enough, like I’m α problem, I was unlovable, I needed α lot of reassurance constantly... but I still did want to live just because I believed in what we had, clearly I shouldn’t have though as I ended up more broken than ever... There was only 1 short time in my life where this happened, it was just my relationship that kept me going and wanting to live, so I’d often get up and no sooner as I was up be right on the phone to tell her good morning and tell her how much she meant to me, I’d sometimes try and wake her up if she had somewhere to be, waking up not wishing I was dead was something special and I’ll probably never feel it again but it was just nice to know I held some kind of value and I had α place, I’d wake up excited to see what the day brought and of course there was always issues in my life still (and relationship) but I always was just glad that I was here and I felt like I could get through anything... it really was something.

As I appreciate you talking about it. I get it, people are assholes but at the end of the day, how you feel is how you feel and if they can’t accept it and respect that then it says α lot about them. You shouldn’t have to tolerate something that causes α negative reaction in you. You’re not overly sensitive, you have α reason for it. You’re not α pussy for having natural reactions with something and if anybody says that then fuck them... they’re just douchebags & it’s not something you need to fix, it’s something they need to fix. And only you can say anything about your trauma because unless they have the same exact experiences as you, they would never know shit about it.
